color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — dark register, pageBackground #19191c (luminance 25.34), accent #fd356e

type-system.twistDescription: Heading fonts replaced with Orbitron (h1: 100px/900, h2: 70px/700) for sci-fi HUD designation aesthetic. JetBrains Mono introduced as mono/button/link family. Figtree retained for body. Questrial for secondary labels. All headings uppercase with compressed tracking.

motion-system.twistDescription: All durations ×0.35 for rapid-fire cyberpunk pacing (base: 0.11s, fast: 0.07s, slow: 0.18s). Stagger 0.04s for cascading data-feed reveals. Easing cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) — mechanical precision. Glitch, scanLine, dataStream, pulseGlow keyframes added.

grid-system.twistDescription: Container set to 100vw, 16px padding each side — full-bleed sensor array layout. .data-grid special layout with 4px #fd356e accent rail column added for HUD data readout aesthetic. .hud-panel with 1px gap hardware grid pattern.

spacing-system.twistDescription: All spacing values compressed to ×0.55 — section.marginTop 264px, section.gap 105.6px, wrapper.padding 8.8px, hero.paddingBottom 285.12px. Tight sensor-array geometry.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Neon halo box-shadow on hover: double ring (inner 2px black + outer 3px accent + 16px glow). Transition: 0.11s cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1) for color/border, 0.06s linear for box-shadow. Focus states amplified with glow expansion. Machine-precise — no bounce, no decay.

nav-system.twistDescription: Typography set to JetBrains Mono 600 weight, uppercase, 0.08em tracking — terminal command-line aesthetic. Height 21px. Frosted glass backdrop-filter on scroll. Dropdown disabled.
nav-system.fixes: fontFamily changed from 'Space Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', monospace to 'JetBrains Mono', monospace per Check C — Space Mono not present in assembled type system

concept-summary.twistDescription: Full defense/sensor-systems register — Defense Neural product world. Operational technology vocabulary throughout: oscilloscope readouts, robotic pick-and-place, aerial sensor sweep. Video brief: slow camera translate over industrial surface (hero), oscilloscope waveform (data section), robotic arm placement macro (product detail).
